english.title: Aid / abet the driving of a motor vehicle otherwise than in accordance with a licence - endorseable offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), otherwise than in accordance with a licence authorising

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

to drive a motor vehicle of that class
english.legislation: Contrary to section 87(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

In a case where the driving would not have been in accordance with any licence that could have been granted to the driver:

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to six penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification

Otherwise no endorsement or disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
